from.place: Upstream master declaration AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.isIso_boundedConstructibleBaseChange_of_isProper; target specialization and comparison with the blueprint theorem

title: AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.CondensedRing.isIso_boundedConstructibleBaseChange_of_isProper
statement: For a prime ℓ, a finite normed field extension E of Q_ℓ, and separated finite-type schemes X,Y,X′,Y′ over a field k of positive prime characteristic different from ℓ, let f,g,f′,g′ be k-morphisms forming a cartesian square with f proper. The bounded constructible pro-étale base-change natural transformation for the condensed ring C(-,E), Rf_* followed by Lg^* to Lg′^* followed by Rf′_*, is an isomorphism of functors.
